entities.title: The workflow and the README name different permissions for the deploy token
entities.summary: README.md asks for DNS: Edit on the Cloudflare API token as well; the workflow's header comment does not.
entities.expected: The workflow's comment and README.md, "Setting it up once (the owner)", list the same permissions for CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.
entities.observed: README.md lists Account → Workers Scripts: Edit, Zone → Workers Routes: Edit and Zone → DNS: Edit; the comment at the top of the workflow lists the first two only.
